recognize_zh: 淋巴結濾泡間區中央可見一個由淡粉紅色上皮樣組織球與多核巨細胞組成的小肉芽腫，周圍為密集小淋巴球，屬 Kimura 病濾泡間的肉芽腫反應。
features: Small non-necrotizing granuloma in the interfollicular region
Epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval nuclei
Multinucleated giant cells with clustered nuclei within the granuloma
Adjacent smaller aggregates of histiocytes and small vessels
Dense background of small mature lymphocytes
describe_en: Lymph node section shows a dense background of small mature lymphocytes within which is a well-formed non-necrotizing granuloma composed of epithelioid histiocytes and multinucleated giant cells. Smaller histiocytic aggregates and small vessels are present nearby in the interfollicular area. No caseous necrosis or atypical large cells are identified in this field. The granulomas are a nonspecific finding; in the context of eosinophilic microabscesses and germinal center IgE deposits, the findings are consistent with Kimura disease.

ddx.vs: Sarcoid granulomas are numerous, tight and confluent, often with asteroid or Schaumann bodies, and lack eosinophilic microabscesses.
Mycobacterial granulomas often have central caseous necrosis with acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Toxoplasmosis shows small epithelioid histiocyte clusters encroaching on germinal centers with monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia, without eosinophil abscesses.
Hodgkin lymphoma may contain granulomas but also has CD30/CD15-positive Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed background.
